description: Writes of the value a slot already holds notify nothing (docs/design/REACTIVITY-ALIASING.md, R4): Vue's set trap and RefImpl compare with SameValue, so a watchEffect reading a deep ref's field, an element and a ref does not run again after such writes, nor after reversing a palindrome (the swapped elements are equal) or a push (a new index and the length); a reversal that changes the element it reads runs it once. Before, natively the watchEffect ran again after every write
